episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Neurosurgeon Tae-ju clashes with his wife Se-yun, the board director of his hospital. Tae-ju demands a divorce. But the next day, his wife vanishes.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Taeju goes to his in-laws for help, only to run into detectives. Another call with no caller ID comes through. Seyun wakes up in a strange room.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Suhyeong gives Taeju an ultimatum: show up at a specific place and time to save his wife, so Taeju makes a daring escape from the police station.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Taeju makes a desperate escape. His hope of seeing Seyun again is short-lived when he's faced with a photo of a brutally murdered woman.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The kidnapper agrees to Taeju's deal. This could be the last chance to save Seyun. Meanwhile, Suhyeong has been following Taeju from a distance.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Having obtained the kidnapper's home address, Taeju hides in a doctor's office from detectives, only to come face-to-face with an unexpected person.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Taeju and Seyun fight for their lives, but Noh Manhui's ferocious determination to kill pushes them to the brink.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Jeongsu's attempt to kill Gyeongae fails. But Taeju is haunted by Jeongsu's claim that he was "just following orders."

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Noh Manhui and the mastermind behind him remain at large. Taeju poses as Gyeongae's doctor to uncover the truth. Jang discovers an unexpected clue.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: After a tense standoff, Taeju and Manhui each uncover pieces of the truth. Meanwhile, Seyun learns the full story of that nightmarish day.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Taeju discovers who's really behind the case, but he's stuck without proof. A fire alarm goes off at night, throwing Woori Medical Center into chaos.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Manhui and Chiung appear before Taeju, and the three head to the care home where Gyeongae is, each with their own goal.
